home.headline_gold: Call Doctor Mower.
home.subheading: Onsite servicing and repairs for all your outdoor power equipment.
home.location_text: Proudly servicing the Somerset region and surrounding areas.
home.about_paragraph_1: Doctor Mower provides professional onsite servicing and repairs for all types of outdoor power equipment.
home.about_paragraph_2: With a focus on quality, reliability and customer satisfaction, we’ll have your equipment running like new again.

services.service: Routine servicing helps keep your machine reliable, running at its best, and can significantly extend the life of your equipment.
services.repair: Repairs to faulty, damaged or worn components to help restore your equipment to reliable working condition.
services.diagnosis: Accurate fault finding to identify the exact issue, with repairs quoted beforehand so there are no unexpected surprises.

booking.heading: Book a Service
booking.intro: Tell us about your machine and what you need.
booking.how_text: Complete the form with as much information as you can. We’ll use it to get back to you about your onsite service or repair.
